purpose: 3-3 inspection before and after uncovering the old tower foundation

entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Edit reference pixel-art RPG tower courtyard background, retaining the exact camera, warm detailed pixel art, same curved tower wall/wood door/steps and surrounding road. 3:2 landscape. Story scene: an archaeological inspection of old foundation stones extending outward from the tower, uncovered beneath a former stairway. Add a NARROW SINGLE LINE of small old squared foundation blocks emerging from tower base at image x38%,y35%, following diagonally toward x51%,y69%. Blocks are mostly soil-covered with a thin strip of grass marking the seam; not a wall or raised staircase. Along this line at x46%,y57%, indicate a very subtle grass-covered buried rectangular socket (NOT visible hole yet), about 3.5% image width and 2.5% image height, two adult palms wide relative to the wooden door. The old stone seam must physically connect to the tower foundation, not be a mysterious isolated rock. Preserve wide flat walkable space to left and right, particularly x55-85% y50-85% for six tiny game characters and a small work table, and x20-45% y60-80%. No people, furniture, items, text, arrows, glowing magic or UI. Do not alter camera or add geographical landmarks. Keep scale matching this reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact RPG tower courtyard background into its AFTER-inspection state. Preserve camera, tower/door/steps, all major ground shapes and pixel-art style pixel-for-pixel where possible. ONLY remove grass and loose soil from the narrow old foundation-stone line that runs from the tower base near x36%,y39% toward x55%,y88%. Expose the same old stone joints continuing from the tower base. The grass-filled rectangular small socket already visible near x45.5%,y63.5% should now be a clearly empty shallow stone-lined recess with dark earthy bottom. Its opening must stay SMALL, same dimensions as the existing grass-filled rectangle, roughly 4% image width and 4% image height including rim; do not enlarge it or make it a well/crater. Adjacent blocks remain embedded flush with the ground, old weathered edges, disturbed soil immediately alongside them. This is a missing two-palms-wide stone from an old tower foundation, not a magical stone or isolated loose object. No glowing marks or magical glyphs. No people, tools, furniture, labels, UI. Same 3:2 landscape and precise composition as input.
